warnings: All classifications are properties of fitted modes, not confirmed objects.
Displayed range extrema cover saved modes, not a confidence interval or exhaustive orbit family.
Known annotations reuse an older pinned export; no-match is not discovery, older astrometric sensitivity remains.
Sizes are conditional on nominal orbit, median reported V, no phase correction and assumed albedo .04/.25; no dwarf-planet classification.
A hyperbolic osculating fit is not interstellar evidence.
The general lane is a supplied prior-result baseline; novel_membership means absent from that exact supplied baseline, not from all historical campaigns.
